meta.name: x-search
meta.description: MUST read before searching X/Twitter with the x_search tool. When xAI is connected: date-bound every time-sensitive query (from_date >= yesterday, widen to 7 days), scope trusted accounts with allowed_x_handles, phrase queries as latest/recent with since:/from:/filter: operators, split into 2-3 searches by account and by keyword, and reconcile against web_search. Triggers: X search, Twitter search, tweets, posts on X, what people are saying on X, x_search, social signal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 锁定最新日期与可信账号，精准搜出X上的相关推文
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常在X上搜索话题，并希望只看最新、来自可信账号的说法。
copy.tagline_en: Find the latest, trustworthy X posts using date and trusted-account filters.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you search X for topics and want up-to-date, credible takes from trusted accounts.

howto.what: Claude 会用 x_search 工具搜 X/Twitter 上的帖子:给时间敏感的问题加日期范围,按可信账号和关键词分成 2 到 3 次搜索,再和网页搜索对照,汇报时给每条说法附上 x.com 链接。
howto.when: 当你提到 X 搜索、Twitter 搜索、推文等关键词,或想了解 X 上人们在说什么时触发。前提是已连接 xAI 账号;没有凭证时会直说 x_search 不可用,改用 web_search。

howto.what_en: Claude uses x_search to search X/Twitter posts: it date-bounds time-sensitive queries, splits into 2-3 searches by trusted account and keyword, reconciles against web_search, and cites an x.com URL per claim.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention X search, Twitter search, tweets, or social signal. Requires a connected xAI account; without a credential Claude says x_search is unavailable and falls back to web_search.
